Proposal 1: Close the Lantern Offices
AN ACT relating to lantern offices.
(A) No public lantern office shall remain open after dusk in the state of [STATE].

1. [Lantern Office at Example Hall A.]
Proposal 2: End Mandatory Lantern Training
AN ACT relating to lantern training.
(A) No institution may make lantern training mandatory.
